```python
def get_group(board, r, c, color, visited, group_id):
    # BFS, returns stones, liberties
    queue = deque([(r, c)])
    stones = [(r, c)]
    visited[r, c] = group_id
    liberties = set()
    
    while queue:
        cr, cc = queue.popleft()
        for dr, dc in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
            nr, nc = cr+dr, cc+dc
            if 0 <= nr < 19 and 0 <= nc < 19:
                if board[nr, nc] == 0:
                    liberties.add((nr, nc))
                elif board[nr, nc] == color and visited[nr, nc] == 0:
                    visited[nr, nc] = group_id
                    queue.append((nr, nc))
                    stones.append((nr, nc))
    return stones, liberties

def analyze_groups(board):
    visited = np.zeros((19, 19), dtype=np.int32)
    groups = {}  # id -> {'stones': [], 'liberties': set(), 'color': int}
    group_map = np.zeros((19, 19), dtype=np.int32) - 1  # -1 for empty/not assigned
    
    gid = 0
    for r in range(19):
        for c in range(19):
            if board[r, c] != 0 and visited[r, c] == 0:
                gid += 1
                color = board[r, c]
                stones, libs = get_group(board, r, c, color, visited, gid)
                groups[gid] = {'stones': stones, 'liberties': libs, 'color': color}
                for sr, sc in stones:
                    group_map[sr, sc] = gid
    return groups, group_map
```
